The Router was generally accurate but overly strict on color and bolt holes.

2. 'Central hub with multiple bolt holes': Router marked False. I agree. The center cap is solid. While real wheels have bolts, they are hidden here. This is a 'Missing' visual feature but not necessarily a structural failure of the generation. 
3. 'Tire tread/sidewall markings': Router marked False. I agree. The tire is smooth/blurry. This is a common AI simplification artifact.
4. Geometry checkpoints: All correctly marked Present.

This confirms the text is structurally malformed/garbled, a hallmark of AI training data leakage or generation failure. It is not just an overlay; it is a corrupted texture. Severity remains high (4.5).

3. New Observation: The tire lacks any sidewall lettering or distinct tread blocks, appearing as a smooth black torus. This 'smoothing' artifact is typical of AI generations struggling with fine repetitive patterns. Severity 2.0.

The lack of fine detail (tread/text) lowers the fidelity score despite correct gross geometry.
